name: Conformance: Secret Resolve Then Fail
description: host-services.md §secrets — node 'resolve-secret' (conformance.secret.echo) resolves the host-provisioned canary 'openwop-conformance-canary-secret' exactly as openwop-smoke-byok-roundtrip does and outputs only {secretSha256, secretLength}; node 'fail' (core.fail) then fails the run.
